name: dsh-devops-tasks
description: My DevOps workbench for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry that loads the three "about me" buckets of the company DevOps platform (待办 / 待审 / 我创建的) into one panel, with counts, type and status chips, due dates and owner, refresh and force-refresh. Data comes from the devops-mcp-agile MCP server through a zero-dependency MCP Streamable-HTTP client in the host process, so the access token never reaches the browser; the endpoint is discovered from the profile's cordis patch files. Ships a sidebar panel plus a loopback-only host route. Zero runtime dependencies.
